metrics.memory_method: process RSS sampled at 10 ms; CUDA allocator peak if available

dataset.name: independent clipped normal scalar samples std=0.35
dataset.encoder_fit_scope: training observations only; validation does not update weights

palette_decoder_control.method: RGB MLP decoding of a separately fitted scalar codebook

non_claims: A learned RGB representation is not automatically better than fixed-point quantization.

codebook.fit_distribution: clipped normal std=0.35, training split only
codebook.objective: joint neural encode/decode MSE with byte STE and RGB neighbor smoothness penalty
